== Loops.counting (line 3)
| counting(n)
  instruction
    | sum := 0
  for style=COUNTER
    | for i := 0 to n - 1
    -
      instruction
        | sum := sum + i
  for style=COUNTER
    | for i := 0 to n by 2
    -
      instruction
        | sum := sum + i
  for style=COUNTER
    | for i := n to 1 by -1
    -
      instruction
        | sum := sum - i
  jump
    | return sum

== Loops.free (line 21)
| free(n)
  instruction
    | sum := 0
  instruction
    | i := 0
  instruction
    | j := n
  while
    | i < j?
    -
      instruction
        | sum := sum + (j - i)
      instruction
        | i := i + 1
      instruction
        | j := j - 1
  instruction
    | i := 0
  forever
    -
      alternative
        | i > n?
        -
          jump
            | break
        -
      instruction
        | i := i + 1
  jump
    | return sum

== Loops.enhanced (line 38)
| enhanced(values)
  instruction
    | sum := 0
  for style=TRAVERSAL
    | foreach v in values
    -
      instruction
        | sum := sum + v
  jump
    | return sum

== Loops.whileLoop (line 48)
| whileLoop(n)
  while
    | n > 10?
    -
      instruction
        | n := n / 2
  jump
    | return n

== Loops.doWhile (line 57)
| doWhile(n)
  repeat
    | !(n > 0)?
    -
      instruction
        | n := n - 1
  jump
    | return n

== Loops.endless (line 66)
| endless()
  forever
    -
      call
        | work()

== Loops.endlessFor (line 74)
| endlessFor()
  forever
    -
      call
        | work()

== Loops.work (line 82)
| work()
